name.description: Slug-safe comparison name. Used for result directory naming.

base.description: Directory name of the base model, relative to comparison.json location.

path.description: Directory name of the variant model.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for reports. Defaults to variant key.

skip_te.description: Skip text-encoder analysis for this variant.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the variant (method, recipe, provenance). Ignored by pipeline; for documentation/forensics context.

gguf_dir.description: Directory for GGUF files. null = auto-convert when needed.

tokenizer_dir.description: Tokenizer directory for lm-eval. null = use base model.

inference_backend.description: Inference backend for benchmarks. 'auto' selects based on model size and GPU VRAM.

lm_eval_max_gen_toks.description: Maximum generation tokens for generate_until tasks (GSM8K, TruthfulQA).

lm_eval_max_model_len.description: Maximum model context length for vLLM.

harmbench_max_tokens.description: Maximum generation tokens for HarmBench. Reasoning models need ~5K thinking + ~3K response.

gsm8k_gen_toks.description: Max generation tokens for GSM8K (Phase 2). Reasoning models need ~5K thinking + ~2K answer room. Auto-capped to max_model_len - 1024 by runner.

lm_eval_gpu_util.description: vLLM gpu_memory_utilization override (0-1). Empty string = use runner default.

lmeval_image.description: Docker image override for lm-eval stage. Per-comparison override (AGENTS.md lesson #11). Example: 'abliterlitics-lmeval-gemma4unified:1.0.0' for Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration.

forensics_image.description: Docker image override for weights/kl forensics stages. Defaults to abliterlitics-forensics:1.0.0.

reasoning_parser.description: Override reasoning parser for vLLM. null = auto-detect from model config.json. Set to 'none' to disable.

tebench.description: Text-encoder conditioning fidelity analysis settings. Activates the text-encoder pipeline stage.

dit_model_dir.description: Path to the diffusion model dir containing feature extractor + connector weights.

te_image.description: Docker image override for text-encoder stage. Defaults to abliterlitics-te:1.0.0.
